formal_statement: have x1 : (Fin (26 : ℕ) → Bool) → Fin (20 : ℕ) → Bool := fun (x1 : Fin (26 : ℕ) → Bool) (x2 : Fin (20 : ℕ)) => if ↑x2 < (17 : ℕ) then x1 (Fin.ofNat (26 : ℕ) (if ↑x2 < (5 : ℕ) then ↑x2 else if ↑x2 < (14 : ℕ) then ↑x2 + (8 : ℕ) else ↑x2 + (9 : ℕ))) else Decidable.decide (↑x2 ≠ (18 : ℕ)) && (x1 (16 : Fin (26 : ℕ)) || x1 (18 : Fin (26 : ℕ))) || Decidable.decide (↑x2 ≠ (17 : ℕ)) && (x1 (19 : Fin (26 : ℕ)) || x1 (23 : Fin (26 : ℕ))); have x2 : Fin (13 : ℕ) → Fin (13 : ℕ) → Prop := fun (x2 x3 : Fin (13 : ℕ)) => ∃ x4 ∈ [(0 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (1 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (3 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), (9 : Fin (13 : ℕ))], x2 = x3 + x4; ∃ (x3 : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 x3 ∧ x3.size ≤ (23 : ℕ) ∧ (∀ (x4 x5 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), ↑x4 < (5 : ℕ) → x2 x4 x5 → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (20 : ℕ) x3 (x1 fun (x8 : Fin (26 : ℕ)) => Decidable.decide (x8 = Fin.castAdd (13 : ℕ) x4 ∨ x8 = Fin.natAdd (13 : ℕ) x5)) = Bool.true) ∧ ∀ (x4 : Fin (26 : ℕ) → Bool), (∀ (x5 x6 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), x4 (Fin.castAdd (13 : ℕ) x5) = Bool.true → x4 (Fin.natAdd (13 : ℕ) x6) = Bool.true → ¬x2 x5 x6) → ((∃ (x6 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), ∀ (x7 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), x4 (Fin.castAdd (13 : ℕ) x7) = Bool.true → x2 x7 x6) ∨ ∃ (x6 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), ∀ (x7 : Fin (13 : ℕ)), x4 (Fin.natAdd (13 : ℕ) x7) = Bool.true → x2 x6 x7) → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.circuitFun (20 : ℕ) x3 (x1 x4) = Bool.false
plain_statement: Plane of order 3 as in the parent. Feed a 20-input circuit from the 26 inputs: x0..x4, the lines other than y9, then y3 OR y5, y6 OR y10, and the OR of those four lines. Some AND/OR circuit of fan-in at most two with at most 23 gates on those 20 inputs is true, so fed, at every incident one-point-one-line input with a point below 5, and false at every input with no incident pair on whose on points all lie on one line or whose on lines all pass through one point.
title: A step toward: Search: an order-3 plane circuit of at most 63 fan-in-two AND/OR gates, true at incident pairs, false at every degenerate maximal false input
